newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Ghee Corp seeks $5.0 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Ghee Corp seeks $5.0 mln bank loan.

text.p: The state-run Ghee Corporation of Pakistan (GCP) said on Thursday it was negotiating for a $5.0 million financing facility with the Jeddah-based Islamic Development Bank (IDB) to import vegetable oil.
"We are negotiating a $5.0 million facility with the IDB which will take some time to finalise," said a GCP official who asked not to be named.
He denied rumours that Pakistan had already clinched IDB financing to import 20,000 to 30,000 tonnes of vegoil. He said this could be speculators trying to move the palmoil market.
Talk that Pakistan had secured up to $10 million in IDB financing to buy vegetable oil and soyoil boosted Malaysian palmoil prices at midday, traders in Kuala Lumpur said.
